verdict.rationale: Together AI's first-party structured-outputs docs say supported models can return JSON that conforms to any schema you supply, so output can be read directly in code without retries or fragile parsing. That is the core of the story. However, it applies only to 'supported models', and the pack has no grammar-based constraint and no independent or hands-on confirmation that enforcement is reliable. missing for 10: list of which models support schema enforcement, grammar/regex-constrained decoding, independent or hands-on corroboration of parse reliability

support.subject: As a developer, I can enforce structured outputs against a JSON schema (or grammar) so model responses parse reliably
